We’re vegetarian and really enjoyed both of the veggie sushi options, along with a few appetisers — everything was delicious. A special mention has to go to Ash, who was absolutely wonderful. He knew it was our anniversary, brought us complimentary drinks and, when we were umming and ahhing about dessert, he surprised us by bringing one over anyway and told us to enjoy it. Such a lovely and thoughtful gesture! He was so friendly, attentive and efficient, and really made us feel looked after. Thank you so much to Ash and everyone at Maki and Ramen for making our 5th anniversary lunch so memorable. We really enjoyed it and will definitely be back! ❤️

reviews.text: (Translated by Google) I usually really like ramen, but this one was a huge disappointment. There are tons of TikToks recommending it, but it's all fake advertising. The only thing that was good was the broth. The meat was unchewable; it formed two clumps in my mouth that I had to spit out into a napkin. For the price, Lanzhou nearby is a thousand times better—cheaper, and they make the noodles right in front of you; they taste great. (Original) Me gusta mucho el ramen normalmente, y este ha dejado mucho que desear. Hay muchos tiktoks recomendándolo y es mucha publicidad fake. Los fideos están poco hechos, y no saben a caseros. La carne no se podía masticar, se me hicieron dos bolas en la boca que tuve que escupir en una servilleta. reviews.author: Nataliia Mishchenko
reviews.text: I honestly don’t even know where to begin because this was such a wonderful experience from start to finish. The food was fantastic, the atmosphere was beautiful, and there was such a lovely harmony throughout the restaurant. But Navin deserves a special mention. In all the restaurants I have visited, I genuinely cannot remember meeting someone who brings such amazing energy to their work. His smile, kindness, bubbly personality and incredibly positive attitude completely stood out. His service was exceptional, but it was much more than just good service. You could genuinely feel his warmth, hospitality and pure kindness. He made us feel welcome, looked after and comfortable from the moment we arrived. His recommendations were absolutely spot-on and honestly made the experience even better. Some people simply do their job, while others have a way of making the whole place feel better just by being there. Navin is definitely the latter. I really struggle to find the right words to describe the positive vibes and wonderful energy he brings to the restaurant. He is a real asset to the team and deserves to be recognised. And I also want to mention the lovely girl who was cleaning the tables towards the end of the evening. I noticed her happily doing her work while having a cute little dance to the music, and honestly, I loved seeing that. It perfectly captured the atmosphere of the whole place — people enjoying what they do, good energy, smiles and genuine harmony. That little moment really stayed with me. ❤️ Amazing food, amazing atmosphere, and truly amazing people. Maki Shoreditch has created something special, and employees like Navin make the experience unforgettable. Thank you, Navin, and thank you to the whole team. I will definitely be coming back! ❤️🍣✨

reviews.author: Sop
reviews.text: if i could give 0 stars i would. Absolutely ridiculous service. I am genuinely appalled at how we were treated. We came in at 4:05pm and were seated at 4:07pm and for the next 30 minutes, not a single person asked us anything. No one checked in, no one came over, we weren’t even given a glance. We were just completely ignored. I eventually had to ask someone if somebody could take our order. I was told “yeah, okay,” and then waited over 10 minutes with nobody coming over. I asked again, and another 10 minutes passed with still nobody taking our order. We asked for a third time, only to then be told that “the system is down.” Yet somehow, the guy holding the ordering iPad was walking around taking orders and payments from other customers??? During all of this, two completely different tables came in after us, were served and had their orders taken before us, and recieved their food. We were literally sitting there watching people who arrived after us get served while nobody bothered to acknowledge us. As well as, The person who came in at the exact same time as us actually left before we had even managed to order. By the time we finally got our food, we were barely even hungry anymore. The food was also quite cold and, honestly, very mid. Nothing terrible, but definitely nothing worth the wait — I’d give it no more than a 5/10. This is honestly ridiculous. I completely understand that places can get busy and that systems can have issues, but there was absolutely no communication or effort to acknowledge us or explain what was happening. Being left waiting for this long while watching other customers being served is incredibly frustrating. The worst part is that it wasnt even busy, the restaurant was pretty empty. I am genuinely appalled at this level of service. We shouldn’t have to repeatedly ask someone just to be acknowledged, let alone to place an order. Absolutely unacceptable.

And of course, the food was great too. Highly recommend the wagyu roll and the foie gras roll. Will happily go back!

reviews.text: Had a fantastic meal at Maki & Nori! The food was absolutely delicious, but what made the night truly special was our server, Carles. He was a complete superstarattentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to make sure we had a great dining experience. We will definitely be back!:)

reviews.author: Nikita Patel
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed in the service we received. We had a reservation for 6, it took them such a long time to take our order. Once we ordered our bottle of white wine it took such a long time to come. One of our glasses was cracked and the wine came warm so we sent it back and requested a cold one which took around 30 minutes to come. By this time we were so fed up because NO waiter came to take our order for food or attend to us. The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority. We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained. Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend. DO NOT GO IF YOU AREN’T AN INFLUENCER.

reviews.author: Flaminia
reviews.text: Nice lovely place in central London, quite a hidden gem. The hand rolls are amazing and the chef selection too, service impeccable and Ginger the manager can really guide you through it. Definitely going back!!

reviews.author: wy zheung
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my dining experience at Maki Nori in Soho! They specialise in hand-rolled Japanese sushi, and their Omakase Set is only £33 for 15 pieces. The ingredients were fresh, fresh, fresh! For a restaurant in central London, I think it offers really good value for money. Overall, I was very impressed with the quality of the food, the flavours, the atmosphere and the price. I especially loved that the hand rolls are made fresh to order. The nori was still wonderfully crispy when served, and the combination with the fresh ingredients was a real highlight!

reviews.author: Thomas Kyritsis
reviews.text: Good sushi here. The food was really fresh and beautiful. It was nice watching the Japanese chef making sushi at the counter, really impressive seeing him work. Overall is great, will be back soon.

reviews.author: Jons Baker
reviews.text: Just found Maki Nori by accident whilst walking through London and what a gem it is. Meticulously prepared sushi, utterly delicious. The homemade plum wine is also delicious and the service could not be better, polite, suoer-friendly and fast. We will come back for a proper meal for sure.

reviews.author: Ana Luiza
reviews.text: definitely amongst the best handroll bars in London and the service was amazing! We loved all the handrolls we tried, particularly the teriyaki salmon one. Hamachi carpaccio was also delicious and the homemade plum wine is a must try if you love a sweet drink! Perfect dinner spot.

reviews.author: m q
reviews.text: The food is so delicious 🤩👏🏻

reviews.author: Daniela
reviews.text: This place is such a gem and the handrools are tasty and prepared with love and attention. I went back twice within a few days and couldn't stop eating. Definitely going back!!
